bibl.title: Cave 169 at Marisa: The Imported Ptolemaic Red Ware.
bibl.seg: Renate Rosenthal-Heginbottom, Cave 169 at Marisa: The Imported Ptolemaic Red Ware.
Journal of Hellenistic Pottery and Material Culture 4 (2019) pp. 59-78, figg.
bibl.note: Hellenistic Marisa is located 40 km to the south-west of Jerusalem. The bulk of ceramic finds, dating from the 3rd to the late 2nd cent. BCE, documents a well-to-do population, linked to existing Eastern Mediterranean trading networks. - Pp. 65-73: Catalogue.
